name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie's journey into motorsport IT began unconventionally. After completing her degree in computer science at École Polytechnique, she spent several years developing software for aerospace companies. The precision and reliability demanded in that field instilled in her a deep respect for robust systems. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Sophie began volunteering at local racing events, eventually leading to an opportunity to overhaul the data infrastructure for a small Formula Renault team. 

Her approach is methodical and uncompromising. Sophie believes that a well-structured IT system is the backbone of any successful team, ensuring seamless communication and rapid data analysis. She is known for her ability to identify and resolve technical bottlenecks quickly, often working independently to implement innovative solutions. Her meticulous nature and high standards are her defining traits. She has a laser focus on delivering reliable and cutting-edge tech solutions. 

Joining MP Motorsport Junior was a strategic move to test her skills in a more competitive environment, and she has rapidly become an essential figure in their data infrastructure.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly parted to the side, often tied back in a low ponytail.
physical.description: Sophie has a slender build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down ideas and to-do lists.
Has a strict schedule for breaks and coffee, regardless of the current situation.
Insists on using a specific brand of mechanical keyboard.
